ننتعش (form VIII)
# نَنْتَعِشُ (nantaʕišu) /nan.ta.ʕi.ʃu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَعَشَ (intaʕaša)
# نَنْتَعِشَ (nantaʕiša) /nan.ta.ʕi.ʃa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَعَشَ (intaʕaša)
# نَنْتَعِشْ (nantaʕiš) /nan.ta.ʕiʃ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْتَعَشَ (intaʕaša)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
